summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing after MongoDB→PostgreSQL migration and Kobo Toolbox webhook integration. Backend: 38/38 pytest tests passed (100%) including 9 new Kobo-specific tests. Frontend: Kobo nav item visible, Kobo page renders config card with webhook URL/token/copy buttons, 6 Kobo submissions listed (created during backend tests), all other pages still load.

minor.issue: webhook_url returns internal cluster hostname (http://geefastapi.cluster-5.preview.emergentcf.cloud/api/kobo/webhook) instead of public HTTPS URL (https://geefastapi.preview.emergentagent.com). Already flagged by main agent as expected-during-preview; flagging again as Kobo Toolbox cannot reach the cluster URL from the public internet, so users would need to manually replace the host. Consider exposing a configurable PUBLIC_BASE_URL env var or deriving from request X-Forwarded-Host.

action_items: (Minor) Expose a PUBLIC_BASE_URL env var or honor X-Forwarded-Host in /api/kobo/info so the displayed webhook URL is the public HTTPS URL Kobo Toolbox can reach.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~960 lines — consider splitting into routers/ modules (auth, alerts, observations, missions, gee, kobo) for maintainability per >700-line guideline.
db.py disables SSL hostname verification (CERT_NONE) — acceptable for Render self-signed but document the rationale and consider verifying with proper CA bundle in production.

JWT cookie samesite='none' + secure=True is correct for cross-site preview; ensure CORS allow_origins is later tightened from '*' once production domain is known (incompatible with credentials in strict browsers).
Kobo webhook accepts 'forest_id' as id/code/name match — works, but consider rejecting submissions when forest cannot be resolved instead of silently storing with forest_id=null.
_extract_kobo_field returns the FIRST matching key but iterates dict keys for suffix match — ordering is dict-insertion order; consider documenting precedence.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (added TestKobo class with 8 tests + stats kobo_submissions test)

seed_data_creation: During testing, several Kobo submissions (TEST_kobo_*) were posted to /api/kobo/webhook and persisted in PostgreSQL kobo_submissions table. Also TEST_alert, TEST_observation, TEST_mission rows created and most were cleaned up. A few TEST_kobo entries remain in DB (visible in frontend) — harmless seed-like data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully migrated to PostgreSQL on Render (asyncpg + SSL CERT_NONE). All endpoints from MongoDB version still work identically. Kobo webhook (/api/kobo/webhook) requires X-Kobo-Token header == KOBO_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Form classification: form_id contains 'verif' → verification, 'infract' → infraction, else observation. Auto-creates Observation with source='kobo' only for observation/verification (not infraction) when lat/lng + forest_id resolved. Nearest-forest matching by squared euclidean on center_lat/lng works. /api/stats/dashboard now includes totals.kobo_submissions. Frontend has /dashboard/kobo route + sidebar nav item 'Soumissions Kobo'. Only minor issue: /api/kobo/info returns internal cluster URL — known limitation in preview env.
rca of the issue: N/A — no failing tests. Single minor observation on webhook_url host already acknowledged by main agent.
